ClientCommand.payload: object; session.new accepts session_mode=chat|study, thinking_mode=default|on|off and experiment_run boolean (internal frozen evaluations only); session.model.set accepts profile_id and model for an idle chat session; message.send accepts images as media ids issued by POST /media/images and research={depth:deep}

_payloads.message.send: {content: string, images?: [{media_id: string}], research?: {depth: deep}}; images come from POST /media/images and require a chat session; deep research creates a cited report
_payloads.session.model.set: {profile_id: string, model: string}; chat session only, no active turn
_payloads.session.rename: {title: string}; ordinary chat only, no active turn
_payloads.session.delete: {}; ordinary chat only, no active turn
_payloads.session.thinking.set: {thinking_mode?: default|on|off, enabled?: boolean, thinking_level?: string, thinking_budget?: integer|null}; chat only, no active turn; enabled remains for older clients
_payloads.session.web.set: {mode: auto|always|off}; chat only, no active turn
_payloads.message.edit: {index: integer, content: string}; chat only, no active turn; index must be a user message
_payloads.message.regenerate: {index: integer}; chat only, no active turn; defaults to the last assistant message
_payloads.message.delete: {index: integer}; chat only, no active turn

_surfaces.cli: 完整会话入口（键盘优先）
_surfaces.web: 本机网页聊天和 Provider 设置

_boundary: 前端不直连 Provider/Memory/Tool；不持有 API Key；统一经 Gateway 进入 Runtime。
